reðr raised this stone in memory of Ásgautr and Gauti, her/his sons. Gauti met his end in Ingvarr's troop.
kviðr and Helga, they raised this stone in memory of Ulfr, their son. He met his end with Ingvarr. May God help Ulfr's soul.

Gunnulfr raised this stone in memory of Ulfr, his father. He was on a voyage with Ingvarr.
